contributors-page: true

<!--  this script is used to move the contributors list to the authors section of the book and to show multiple authors as comma separated list.  -->
<script>
const contributors = document.querySelector('#contributors-list');
const authorsHeading = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.quarto-title-meta-heading'))
	.find((heading) => heading.textContent.trim() === 'Authors');
const authorsContents = authorsHeading?.nextElementSibling;
if (authorsContents) {
	const authorParagraphs = Array.from(authorsContents.querySelectorAll('p'));
	if (authorParagraphs.length > 1) {
		const combinedAuthors = document.createElement('p');
		combinedAuthors.innerHTML = authorParagraphs.map((paragraph) => paragraph.innerHTML.trim()).join(', ');
		authorsContents.replaceChildren(combinedAuthors);
	}
}
const authorsBlock = authorsHeading?.parentElement;
if (contributors && authorsBlock) {
	authorsBlock.appendChild(contributors);
}
</script>

<script>
const creditStatement = document.querySelector('details');
const abstract = document.querySelector('#title-block-header .abstract');
if (creditStatement && abstract) {
	abstract.parentElement.insertBefore(creditStatement, abstract);
}
</script>
